name: Surprise
when: Unexpected result · an outlier in the data

variants.name: Gasp
variants.desc: Sucks in a breath, stretches tall and its eyes pop wide.

variants.name: Jump back
variants.desc: Jumps up and back in shock, then lands with a squash.

variants.name: Double take
variants.desc: Glances, looks away, then snaps back with huge eyes.

variants.name: Boing
variants.desc: Stretches tall like a spring and wobbles back into shape.

variants.name: Pop
variants.desc: Pops bigger in a flash with shock lines all around.
